principles.name: Optical Tracking Contrast
principles.heuristic: Display titles >= 48px MUST use negative tracking (-0.03em to -0.05em). Small pill metadata caps <= 12px MUST use positive tracking (+0.12em to +0.18em).

principles.name: Optimal Character Measure
principles.heuristic: Body text line length MUST be constrained between 45 and 75 characters per line to optimize visual reading velocity.
